Retains the strike for next over 43.5 6 Pawan Sarraf to Tilak Varma, SIX , tossed up delivery, on the sticks, Tilak Varma sits down and slams the slog sweep over deep mid. Massive hit by the southpaw. Clean hit by Tilak to take him to 96. The rate is now more than 6 per over. Might have been an inside edge on to the pads. There was an appeal but too many doubts in the mind of the umpire 26.1 Pawan Sarraf to Kumar Kushagra, no run, flatter one, outside off, patted down into the off-side and Kumar Kushagra wanted a single but was sent back 10.6 Pawan Sarraf to Kumar Kushagra, no run, good length outside off, Kushagra gets forward and knocks it down the pitch 10.5 Pawan Sarraf to Kumar Kushagra, no run, flat length ball outside off, Kushagra shuffles across on the back foot and steers to point 10.4 Pawan Sarraf to Kumar Kushagra, no run, punched from the crease into the on-side 10.3 W Pawan Sarraf to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, out Bowled!! What a start this is for Nepal. Three wickets in the first 11 overs, including both dangerous openers. Again, it's another big shot attempt that leads to a wicket. Just not the pitch where you can hit through the line with ease. Drifting in on middle from round the wicket, Sooryavanshi clears the front leg to launch it straight but the ball grips, holds, and turns past the edge to open him up. Goes on to hit the top of middle and Sarraf is delighted. He wasn't even supposed to bowl this over but Bhurtel hadn't served his penalty time so they continued with him.
